- TAM coverage hours (local vs. US support, timezones covered) and on-call rotation details.
- Primary and secondary incident contacts for P1/P2 incidents, including phone and escalation email alias.

- Any blackout windows or maintenance notification policy.

Hi Jill,

Thanks — we can definitely provide that. I’m attaching a service coverage spreadsheet and our latest TAM roster to this thread (see files listed). High-level answers below; Marissa and Laura are looped for accuracy and any additions.

- TAM coverage hours: Primary TAM coverage 08:00–18:00 PT (Mon–Fri) for US accounts by default; 24x7 on-call available as an add-on for P1 incidents with guaranteed handoff. For multi-region customers we provide local-hour overlap planning during onboarding.

- On-call rotation: Our on-call rotation is a 7x24x365 pager rotation for P1s (two-week rotations per engineer), staffed by a dedicated escalation pool. TAMs handle day-to-day and P2s during their coverage window.

- Contacts & escalation: Primary contact = tam-primary@redwood.com (monitored 08:00–18:00 PT). P1 escalation alias = p1-escalations@redwood.com (alerts to the on-call rotation + SRE duty). We include phone escalation for P1s: +1-415-555-0123 (escalation bridge).

- SLA response expectations: P1 initial response target: 15 minutes (with on-call). P2: 1 hour during business hours. P3: 4 business hours. These are our standard targets; we can contractually tighten for Dedicated customers.

- Incident comms cadence example: initial acknowledgement (T+15m), triage update (T+1h), status updates every 1–2 hours until mitigation, and a post-incident RCA delivered within 5 business days for major incidents.

- Maintenance & notifications: We provide planned maintenance windows with a 72-hour advanced notice and a separate emergency maintenance notification channel. Customers can opt into weekly maintenance windows.

I’ve attached: Redwood_Service_Coverage_Chart.xlsx (spreadsheet with the table you requested) and TAM_Roster_v2.pdf (names/roles/contact routing). If you want a short call at 11:30 PDT, I can join.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
